description: Miles' own estimate of a loyalty point's value in cents, optionally multiplied by a balance. A cash balance such as Uber Cash is valued as a share of face value (0.9 is 90%). Call with no arguments to list every program Miles values, with the exact spelling to use. These are Miles' estimates, not market prices. Attribute them. Card facts only: no earning rates, welcome-offer amounts, transfer ratios, or bonus sizes.

points.description: A balance to value, in points, or in dollars for a cash balance such as Uber Cash.

program.description: Loyalty program, e.g. 'World of Hyatt'. Matched loosely. Omit to list all.
